$comment: INTERNAL — packed shipping facts for the photographed intake stock.
This file is operational data, not marketing copy. It never reaches the storefront.
How each figure was arrived at:
basis 'OWNER_WEIGHED'  — the owner put the packed item on a scale. Used as-is.
basis 'ESTIMATED'       — derived from the product's published specification.
The script applies a safety uplift before it stores
the number, so an estimate always errs on the heavy
side. The store never quotes LESS than the courier
will charge, which is the only safe direction.
When a real item is weighed in the shop, open the product in the admin area,
replace the weight and box size with the measured numbers and set
Measurement source to 'Measured'. That entry then becomes authoritative.
productGrams  the bare item, before any box
packagingGrams box, bubble wrap and tape allowance
boxCm         packed size as L x W x H, the outer carton, not the product
note          why these figures, for the admin record
